schema.author: research analyst (landscape task), for the FACTORY conductor
schema.units: fees and half-spreads in basis points of notional per side unless stated; financing in basis points per year; markup_bp = spread over the stated benchmark, paid by BOTH long and short (long pays benchmark + markup, short receives benchmark - markup) unless detail says otherwise
schema.multi_class_fields: fee_bp_taker, fee_bp_maker, min_fee_per_order, typical_half_spread_bp, financing_*_bp_year, min_order_notional and leverage_caps are objects keyed by instrument class or symbol when a venue offers several

labels.VERIFIED: read on 2026-11-10 on the venue's own page, legal PDF or public API (by me or by a sub-analyst who recorded a verbatim quote)
labels.MEASURED: one public order-book or funding snapshot/series taken on 2026-11-10 - a point-in-time observation, not a typical value
labels.DERIVED: arithmetic on VERIFIED or MEASURED inputs
labels.CLAIM: third party, search extract, or a marketing 'from' / worked-example figure
labels.UNKNOWN: not verified; the value is null
